title: Inspect hydraulic system
description: Check hydraulic lines, seals, and fluid levels for leaks or wear.

title: Refuel machine
description: Top up fuel tank before next shift.

title: Replace drill bit
description: Worn drill bit detected. Replace with spare from depot.

title: Haul material to Zone B
description: Transport excavated material from current position to Zone B stockpile.

title: Perform safety check
description: Pre-shift safety inspection per site protocol.

title: Lubricate moving parts
description: Apply grease to all joints and pivot points per maintenance schedule.

title: Clear debris from path
description: Remove rock debris blocking haul road between Zone A and Zone C.

title: Calibrate sensors
description: Recalibrate payload and engine sensors after maintenance.

title: Check tire pressure
description: Inspect and adjust tire pressure on all wheels.

title: Operator handover
description: Complete shift handover checklist and brief incoming operator.

title: Engine diagnostic
description: Run onboard diagnostic after engine warning light triggered.

title: Wash down machine
description: Clean machine exterior to prevent corrosion and maintain visibility.

title: Replace filters
description: Swap air and oil filters per 250-hour service interval.

title: Inspect bucket teeth
description: Check excavator bucket teeth for wear; replace if below minimum depth.

title: Battery check
description: Test battery voltage and terminals before cold-weather shift.

title: Haul material to crusher
description: Deliver loaded material to primary crusher station.

title: Reposition to Zone D
description: Move machine to Zone D for next excavation phase.

title: Coolant level check
description: Inspect coolant reservoir and top up if below minimum mark.

title: Track tension adjustment
description: Adjust crawler track tension to spec after extended operation.

title: Emergency breakdown response
description: Machine reported breakdown. Dispatch mechanic and assess damage.
